newsitem.title: SPAIN: Retail demand for Repsol twice offer - paper.
newsitem.headline: Retail demand for Repsol twice offer - paper.

text.p: Retail demand for shares of Repsol, whose final 10 percent state stake was put on sale on Monday, was double the offer, local press reported.
Private investors have put in offers for 24 million shares compared to the 12.7 million initially reserved for this stake, according to the financial daily "Diario de los Negocios."
The period for provisional buy offers will end April 21, the day the maximum price will be fixed on April 28 the offer price will be made public.
In addition to the general retail tranche, the initial offer also reserves 10.2 million shares for institutions, 4.5 million shares for employees and 2.5 million for the green shoe option.
On Tuesday, Repsol continued to rise, closing up 50 pesetas to 6,010, just 20 pesetas from its historic maximum.
